👾 SpaceInvader

Classic space shooter: alien invaders descend row by row, picking up speed as their numbers dwindle. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Use left/right arrows to move your laser cannon.
  2. Press Space to fire — you can only have one shot on screen at a time.
  3. Shoot the aliens before they descend to the bottom of the screen.
  4. Watch their movement pattern — they reverse direction and speed up as fewer remain.
  5. Some aliens may drop toward you — stay alert.
